name: WALKFLOW Demo — Real Estate: Expired Session Cleanup

parameters.content: PREPARED, NOT TESTED. Runs on a schedule (default: hourly) rather than a webhook. Calls the demo_real_estate_cleanup_expired_sessions() Postgres function defined in supabase/migrations/0001_real_estate_demo.sql via Supabase's RPC endpoint. Deleting a session cascades to every table referencing it (enquiries, matches, viewings, tasks, message previews, activity events) via ON DELETE CASCADE — restarting a demo session on the website already gets a fresh session id, so this only cleans up abandoned ones.
